name: Topologically Defined Isosurfaces
definition: A method to extract a topologically correct isosurface from a volumetric image by modifying the Marching-Cubes configuration table based on digital geometry connectedness, ensuring the surface is a closed, oriented 2-manifold without singularities or self-intersections that separates foreground from background.
summary: Topologically Defined Isosurfaces extracts closed 2-manifolds from binary volumes by modifying Marching Cubes with digital geometry connectedness to ensure topological correctness.
